resources.string: The most natural way to relieve spinal discs during growth years.
Holding your breath and tensing your shoulders.

string-array.name: ex_y1_1_steps
string-array.item: Grip a pull-up bar with straight arms and feet off the floor.
Relax your shoulders and lower back so gravity gently lengthens your spine.

resources.string: Forcing lower back past comfortable range.

string-array.name: ex_y1_2_steps
string-array.item: Lie face down with palms placed flat beneath your shoulders.
Keeping hips on the mat, press your chest up and look forward.

resources.string: Builds a tall, upright posture habit.
Inhale deeply as you reach up.

string-array.name: ex_y1_3_steps
string-array.item: Interlace fingers and stretch as tall as possible toward the ceiling.
Rise onto tiptoes for 5 seconds, then gently bend side to side.

resources.string: Turns your Achilles tendon into a powerful spring.
Slamming heels hard into the floor.

string-array.name: ex_y2_1_steps
string-array.item: Keep knees slightly bent and bounce fast off the balls of your feet.
Spring upward immediately on contact like a coiled spring.

string-array.name: ex_y2_2_steps
string-array.item: Jump maximally and tuck both knees up toward your chest mid-air.
Extend legs back down and land softly with bent knees.

resources.string: Powers the final push of every jump.

string-array.name: ex_y2_3_steps
string-array.item: Stand on one foot at the edge of a step, lowering the heel fully.
Drive up onto the ball of your foot to the highest peak.

resources.string: Grooves textbook squat form without heavy spinal load.

string-array.name: ex_y3_1_steps
string-array.item: Lower slowly over 3 full seconds with chest proud.
Pause 1 second at the bottom, then stand up cleanly.

string-array.name: ex_y3_2_steps
string-array.item: Place hands on a sturdy bench or table edge.
With a straight body line, lower chest toward the edge and press back.

resources.string: Safest progression toward full pull-ups during growth.
Jutting your head forward to touch the bar.

string-array.name: ex_y3_3_steps
string-array.item: Hold a waist-high bar underneath with a rigid straight body.
Pull your chest up to meet the bar, then lower with control.

resources.string: Fixes tech neck from study & screens.
Nodding your chin down toward the chest.

string-array.name: ex_y4_1_steps
string-array.item: Sit upright or stand with your back against a wall.
Without tilting down, glide your chin straight back and hold 3 seconds.

resources.string: Pulls rounded shoulders back into alignment.

string-array.name: ex_y4_2_steps
string-array.item: Rest forearms vertically on a doorway frame at 90 degrees.
Step one foot gently forward to open the front of your chest.

resources.string: Protects shoulder health and builds upright posture.
Exhale as you push shoulders wide.

string-array.name: ex_y4_3_steps
string-array.item: In a plank position with straight arms, squeeze shoulder blades together then push apart.

resources.string: Keep your center of gravity low.

string-array.name: ex_y5_1_steps
string-array.item: From an athletic half-squat, shuffle 3 steps right and 3 steps left quickly.

resources.string: Letting the standing knee collapse inward.

string-array.name: ex_y5_2_steps
string-array.item: Balance on one leg and tap/reach the other foot forward, sideways, and back without touching down.

resources.string: Keep your back flat like a tabletop.
Spiking your hips high in the air.

string-array.name: ex_y5_3_steps
string-array.item: Start on all fours with knees hovering 3 cm off the floor; crawl forward moving opposite hand and foot.

resources.string: Strengthens core with zero lower-back strain.
Letting lower back arch off the floor.

string-array.name: ex_y6_1_steps
string-array.item: Lie on your back with arms straight up and knees bent at 90 degrees.
Press your lower back into the floor and lower opposite arm and leg smoothly.

resources.string: Clean form matters far more than duration.

string-array.name: ex_y6_2_steps
string-array.item: Elbows directly beneath shoulders, hold a straight line from head to heels.

resources.string: Hips dipping to the lifted side.

string-array.name: ex_y6_3_steps
string-array.item: Hold the top of a glute bridge and lift alternating knees cleanly.

resources.string: Unmatched for coordination and heart health.
Breathe in and out through your nose.

string-array.name: ex_y7_1_steps
string-array.item: Perform light, rhythmic hops on the balls of your feet.

string-array.name: ex_y7_2_steps
string-array.item: Step backward smoothly with torso tall, then drive up cleanly.

resources.string: Quickly lowers heart rate and sharpens focus.

string-array.name: ex_y7_3_steps
string-array.item: Inhale 4 sec, hold 4 sec, exhale 4 sec, hold 4 sec.

resources.string: Builds posture and real pull-up strength together.

string-array.name: ex_yp1_1_steps
string-array.item: While hanging straight, depress shoulder blades downward without bending arms, then relax into a full hang.

string-array.name: ex_yp1_2_steps
string-array.item: Step off a low box softly and immediately explode upward into a vertical jump.

resources.string: Builds upper-body muscle safely during teen years.

string-array.name: ex_yp1_3_steps
string-array.item: Complete 10 controlled push-ups, then hold a plank for 30 seconds right away.
